decisions.reason: Piqué upholstery fabric builds directly on the firm's core upholstery and weaving knowledge, allowing effective interpretation of early results and improvement.
Semi-transparent bouclé-effect fabric leverages existing decorative fabric and sheer curtain capabilities, so the firm can learn from feedback and refine it.
Flame-retardant jacquard curtain combines the firm's established jacquard weaving and functional finishing expertise, ensuring high absorptive capacity.
Double-face wool-blend decoration fabric aligns with sustainability goals but requires somewhat new construction knowledge, giving moderate drop risk while still worth keeping.
The leno weave is less related to existing production knowledge, making it hard to interpret early results and improve, so the firm likely drops it.
